title: Requesting protected motor vehicle data
text:
Motor vehicle information
Overview
You can search for protected motor vehicle information if you:
are requesting your own information
are allowing someone else to request your information with your written consent
have an approved Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR) Agreement and valid account number
have a court order
are a bankruptcy trustee
For detailed information and instructions on how to request information, please refer to the documents below or contact a registry agent for assistance.
AMVIR
controls the release of information by the Registrar to recipients with an AMVIR authorized purpose through AMVIR Agreements.
All employees of an organization that require access to motor vehicle information are required to read the
AMVIR Recipient’s Employees Code of Conduct Regarding Access to and Release of Information
, hereafter called "the Code
."
The Code is part of the Policies referred in the AMVIR Agreement. This Code and any subsequent versions published on the Registrar’s website come into full force and effect and apply 30 days after the date of publication.
